game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Sand Dunes – Caravan Camp, a caravan camp: the oasis keeper must handle vultures while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Pseudocode Bridge: Convert plain-language pseudocode into working code steps to cross the gap.
theme: Sand Dunes – Caravan Camp: a caravan camp
core_gameplay_loop: In Caravan Camp, repeat each round: Convert plain-language pseudocode into working code steps to cross the gap. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the bridge value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the palm grove using at most 17 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The palm grove reached with actions_used <= 17.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 17 before the palm grove is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 7 (applied tier): Pseudocode Bridge
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Pseudocode Bridge' (Week 9 slot 11), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Caravan Camp'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how bridge changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against vultures in Caravan Camp.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The palm grove reached with actions_used <= 17.
